<thought>Now that I know the valid functional group names, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a ketone and a C‑C triple bond (both are listed as “ketones” and “C‑C triple bonds”) and that form a new C‑C bond, which matches the described cycloaddition. This should return a suitable retrosynthetic template for a single‑step disconnection.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": null,
  "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
  "bonds_broken": null,
  "bonds_order_changed": null,
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
